shared_conventions.schema: SOUL fields (character_id, traits[].evidence, motivation.core/shifts, habits, taboos, facade) plus temperament, motivation.fear/wants_from_alice, decision_pattern, waking_life_embodiment, performance_baseline; optional consistency_notes.
shared_conventions.evidence_format: chapter = chNNN; ref = structured_story paragraph ID chNNN-pNN; event = ev*; 'quote' fields are verbatim (machine-checked), 'note' fields paraphrase.
shared_conventions.facade: facade.applies=false + reason where the source has no surface/true split (no nulls).
shared_conventions.waking_life_embodiment: Every card maps the dream figure to an adult/authority trait from Alice's waking 1862 life (realistic coming-of-age reading). All of these are inferred:true with a reason, grounded in world.json wonderland_real_counterparts and the clergyman-scholar household (ruling 5.6 A). Bill and the Knave are mapped as objects of authority (the underling and the accused) rather than as authorities.
shared_conventions.SUP-002: Physical habits for animal-coding are marked inferred:true and follow each index performer_concept; all figures are human performers.
shared_conventions.boundary: No speech-style content (catchphrases, diction) — that belongs to 03-characters/dialogue-style; no relationships — 03-characters/relationship; no voice — voiceprint.
